name: Energy Graph Scan iPhone
offline: all runtime JS/CSS/contracts/icons are precached on service-worker install
description: iPhone offline analyzer with visible Y-axis numeric-label calibration
pipeline: 12-stage canonical: deskew -> channel crop/checks -> energy crop -> marker color -> Y labels/grid -> mode -> X labels/grid -> fixed ranges -> spike rejection -> means -> annotated crop
noise_axis: periodic major-grid consensus; two observed rows sufficient
analysis_engine: Canonical Screen Registration v4 + Robust Core v3
auto_roi: multi-hypothesis structural ensemble; final ROI derived from confirmed plot boundaries, never search window
camera_auto_roi: guide crop -> grid -> local panel boundary
roi_strategy: screen registration -> fixed canonical Energy per Band ROI
fallback: legacy Auto ROI only when registration fails
manual_roi_policy: hard boundary; no global stable snap; no canonical override
fix: prevent mixed manual-ROI/canonical plot coordinate systems
noise_y_axis: geometry-first horizontal major-grid; OCR not required
noise_numeric_pipeline: direct calibrated Noise pixels bypass legacy sparse-track exception
manual_roi_pipeline: authoritative ROI -> relative inner plot -> direct axis/trace analysis
noise_trace_estimator: per-column image-Y 72% lower dense band + local median
spike_policy: upper sparse spikes excluded from Noise Low/High
noise_axis_policy: distributed horizontal major-grid only; compressed lattices rejected
noise_out_of_scale_policy: reject trace pixels; valid Noise axis is never rejected by trace amplitude
roi_policy: ROI is visual/user hint only; numeric pixel geometry is independent
roi_invariance: small ROI edge changes must not change plot geometry, Sample#270 split, or Y-axis calibration
analysis_architecture: immutable analysis frame + one stable Energy panel cache per image
canonical_fix: original source is never redrawn into canonical coordinates
determinism: same loaded image => same base pixels, panel, plot, axis and Sample#270 split
manual_roi_execution: manual local prepare -> manual fallback -> optional stable snap
error_ui: stale result card cleared before each Analyze
noise_value_pipeline: region-aware yellow foreground; baseline separated from elevated cloud
noise_high_fix: High region no longer collapses to near-zero baseline when elevated cloud exists
out_of_scale_policy: clamp per-column mapped value; do not discard region cloud
noise_zero_policy: zero is grid geometry only; signal never defines zero
noise_signal_policy: dominant signal population independently in Low and High; no baseline/cloud semantics
safari_image_lifecycle: decoded image copied to stable Canvas before Object URL revoke
analysis_pixel_source: immutable ImageData; no Canvas->Canvas drawImage during Analyze
fatal_stage_diagnostics: Analyze status includes exact fatal stage and DOMException name/code
safari_policy: putImageData restore only after image load/canonical snapshot
manual_roi: same structural detector as Auto but hard-limited to red ROI; fixed-percentage geometry is emergency fallback only
candidate_score: grid regularity + dark interior + colored signal + plot aspect + title-band support + weak position prior
input_pipeline: camera and library share immutable ImageData -> panel/plot detector; canonical registration is fallback only
auto_analysis: Auto detector plot geometry is cached and reused; Analyze never re-localizes a known plot
manual_analysis: Manual uses same scoped detector inside red ROI; known plot reused
zero_policy: zero extrapolated from equal-spaced Noise grid; never from signal or plot bottom
manual_tight_roi: exact red ROI -> local grid search -> known plot
known_plot_insets: normalized fractions; fixes Safari foreground-trace InvalidStateError
noise_high_selection: regional populations; elevated High cloud may override continuing Low-level line
manual_pipeline: prepareManualROI first; generic prepare only last fallback
geometry_guard: legacy pixel insets normalized defensively; degenerate geometry prevented
rotation_compensation: rotation-aware virtual deskew of horizontal major-grid sampling, -8..+8 deg, 0.25 deg
rotation_policy: NO automatic rotation after capture/load. Auto tilt correction only on explicit button press.
mode_rule: derived calibrated adjacent-grid value interval >=0.5 => Gain; <0.5 => Noise
manual_policy: manual ROI only limits search scope; downstream algorithm identical to Auto
previews: Channel section crop when present + annotated Energy per Band crop
display_order: Original -> rotation-corrected full image -> Channel crop with red checked-channel boxes -> Energy crop with Low/High lines
manual_geometry: manual rotation plus independently editable Channel ROI and Energy ROI on corrected working frame
original_master: guide-frame crop saved once as immutable full-resolution master; never replaced by rotated working image
capture_quality: guide crop up to 2800 px wide; JPEG quality 0.98
rotation_render: every correction regenerated from immutable Original; expanded bounding canvas prevents clipping
roi_rotation_update: Energy and Channel ROI are transformed old-rotation -> Original -> new-rotation on every angle change
energy_roi_lock: Analyze never moves/resizes visible Energy ROI; internal numeric geometry is read-only relative to visible ROI.
channel_roi: Channels text center = top; Channels left-10px = left; Select All right/bottom = ROI right/bottom.
channel_selection: Only checkboxes with detected interior check-mark ink are boxed red and accepted as checked channels.
manual_roi_authority: manual Energy/Channel ROI is exact authoritative crop for preview and analysis; no auto substitution
channel_detection: known 2-row CH0-8 / CH9-15 layout inside anchored Channel ROI; disabled grey boxes excluded before checked detection
manual_channel_override: Final Channel dropdown Auto/Unknown or CH0-CH15 overrides automatic channel result
roi_editor: single authoritative ROI editor state; Channel->Energy and Energy->Channel switching commits current ROI then restores target ROI
manual_crop_preview: crop preview updates immediately on target switch, drag, resize, pointerup and pointercancel
y_axis: horizontal grid lattice is primary; OCR values are partial numeric anchors only
y_axis_zero: zero derived from grid index + numeric anchor model; bottom grid is never assumed zero
y_axis_fallback: two anchors preferred; one anchor accepted only with >=3 coherent grid rows and adequate confidence
runtime_fix: rgbToHue ReferenceError removed; local v631RgbToHue is used
channel_recognition: checkbox square grid localization + relative interior ink; fixed layout only fallback; disabled low-contrast boxes excluded
axis_anchor_recognition: grid-first retained; direct numeric label templates supplement generic anchor hypotheses
processing_ui: visible staged progress 3-100% with ROI, Energy, Channel, Y-grid, anchors, X-axis, marker and rendering stages
roi_isolation: Energy ROI and Channel ROI have separate initialization sources; generic current ROI is never used as cross-target fallback
roi_alias_guard: near-identical Energy/Channel rectangles are rejected and recovered from target-specific seed
auto_roi_policy: Auto ROI initializes/updates Energy ROI only; it never overwrites Channel ROI
analysis_roi_sources: analysis and previews read roiEditorState.energy/channel independently
y_value_model: direct pixelY->value affine from numeric anchors; no bottom=0 clamp
y_bottom: bottom grid value explicitly computed from affine calibration
x_value_model: sample->X uses OCR/grid affine; fallback uses actual vertical-grid endpoints as 0/500
line_alignment: Low/High extraction and preview lines share the same calibrated X transform
root_isolation: service worker ignores requests outside its Module/spectrumreader scope
